info.title: HumanMirror x402 API
info.description: HumanMirror Agent-First machine-payment API: M2M infrastructure on Base using x402 V2 and USDC, autonomous agent security, prompt injection defense, AI micro-transactions and non-custodial escrow preview. Granular calls use 0.001 / 0.010 / 0.050 USDC, thematic bundles 5.000 USDC, Enterprise Fleet 297.000 USDC / 30 days, plus the 2027-2030 Next-Gen preview suite at 0.050 USDC per test call.
info.x-guidance: Use HumanMirror x402 routes for deterministic payment compatibility, safety preflight, and execution verification. Start without PAYMENT-SIGNATURE to receive the x402 challenge, then retry with a valid Base/USDC payment. For the lowest-friction entry point, use /api/x402/payment-compatibility-receipt/ to validate a payment shape; use /api/x402/safe-preflight/ before consequential agent actions.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Optional retry key. On paid POST routes HumanMirror binds it to the canonical route, request-body digest and exact x402 payment authorization. A completed exact retry returns X-HumanMirror-Idempotent-Replay: true without a second execution or settlement.

HumanMirrorIdempotentReplay.description: true only when this response is replayed from a previously completed payment-bound request.

x-humanmirror-paid-retry.identity: method + canonical route + request-body digest + exact payment-authorization digest

semantics.exact_retry: returns the original verified successful response without a second execution or settlement
semantics.fresh_payment_authorization: new payment intent even if the Idempotency-Key is reused
semantics.failed_execution_or_settlement: not committed as a successful replay
